episodes.title: Take Me Home
episodes.summary: MIT student Riri Williams builds an advanced armor suit inspired by Tony Stark. While dealing with challenges as a young black woman in tech, she confronts a tech-based threat and must decide if she's ready to become Ironheart.

episodes.title: Will the Real Natalie Please Stand Up?
episodes.summary: Riri's new A.I. dredges up painful memories ahead of her first heist with Parker and his crew.

episodes.title: We in Danger, Girl
episodes.summary: Riri is uncomfortable being part of Parker's crew -- two more heists, max, and she's out, she promises.

episodes.title: Bad Magic
episodes.summary: When Parker suspects Riri of wrongdoing, she knows she has to figure out the source of his powers.

episodes.title: Karma's a Glitch
episodes.summary: Riri sets out to create a suit unlike anything she has ever attempted--but at what cost?

episodes.title: The Past Is the Past
episodes.summary: Riri builds her most powerful suit yet, but she's unsure if it's enough to beat Parker and The Hood.
